title: Harsh review of researcher-harness research quality
topic: Evaluate whether researcher-harness is actually performing evidence-backed research or mostly transforming structured prompts into plausible ranked outputs.
question: What is weak, shallow, misleading, or insufficiently evidenced in researcher-harness as currently built, and what is the smallest bounded slice that would materially improve research quality rather than just artifact production?
success_condition: Produce a harsh assessment of researcher-harness research quality, identify the top bounded stabilization candidate, and justify it with evidence from the current runtime and output behavior.
self_review_focus: Do not reward coherent formatting, candidate ranking neatness, or good contract shape if the underlying evidence extraction and critique process is weak. Penalize shallow synthesis, unsupported ranking, and generic proposals.
constraints: Assume the runtime may currently be producing output that looks more rigorous than it really is.
Focus on evidence extraction, critique depth, source use, and recommendation quality.
Prefer bounded improvements over broad redesign unless the current model is fundamentally unsound.
Treat artifact production without decision-quality gain as a failure mode.

hypotheses.statement: The harness currently ranks and promotes candidates more from request metadata and option structure than from independently extracted evidence.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: The review will identify stronger evidence-extraction and critique mechanisms as the highest-value improvement area.
hypotheses.falsifiable_condition: The runtime already demonstrates robust evidence-backed reasoning independent of input option framing.
evidence_required: current harness request and response contracts

hypotheses.statement: A small bounded slice can materially improve research quality without redesigning the entire harness.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: The top recommendation will be a narrow implementation slice rather than a broad rewrite.
hypotheses.falsifiable_condition: The system is so shallow structurally that only a larger redesign would meaningfully help.

required_sources.title: Local researcher-harness contracts and runtime docs
Recent whole-system review outputs
required_sources.note: Primary evidence that the previous harsh review remained too shallow.

options.summary: Strengthen evidence extraction and require findings to cite explicit extracted evidence before candidate ranking.
Strengthen the self-review layer so weak evidence and shallow conclusions are called out more aggressively.
risks: may diagnose weakness without fixing core evidence generation

options.summary: Add more study-design or domain-plugin behavior before tightening evidence quality.
risks: likely increases complexity before the core research quality problem is solved
